verses.ar: وَلَمَّا كَمُلَ لَهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَرْبَعُونَ سَنَةً عَلٰى أَوْفَقِ الْأَقْوَالِ لِذَوِي الْعَالِمِيَّةْ ۞ بَعَثَهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى لِلْعَالَمِينَ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَعَمَّهُمْ بِرُحْمَاهْ ۞ وَبُدِئَ إِلَى تَمَامِ سِتَّةِ أَشْهُرٍ بِالرُّؤْيَا الصَّادِقَةِ الْجَلِيَّةْ ۞ فَكَانَ لَا يَرَى رُؤْيًا إِلَّا جَاءَتْ مِثْلَ فَلَقِ صُبْحٍ أَضَاءَ سَنَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-lammā kamula lahu ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama arbaʿūna sanatan ʿalā awfaqi l-aqwāli li-dhawi l-ʿālimiyyah, baʿathahu Llāhu taʿālā li-l-ʿālamīna bashīran wa-nadhīran fa-ʿammahum bi-ruḥmāh, wa-budi'a ilā tamāmi sittati ash-hurin bi-r-ru'ya ṣ-ṣādiqati l-jaliyyah, fa-kāna lā yarā ru'yan illā jā'at mithla falaqi ṣubḥin aḍā'a sanāh.
verses.en: When he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, reached forty years of age, according to the most reliable of the opinions held by the learned, Allah Most High sent him to all the worlds as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner, encompassing them with His mercy through him. He was first given clear and truthful dreams for a period of six months, and he would see no dream except that it came to pass like the breaking of dawn, radiant with light.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّمَا ابْتُدِئَ بِالرُّؤْيَا تَمْرِينًا لِلْقُوَّةِ الْبَشَرِيَّةْ ۞ لِئَلَّا يَفْجَأَهُ الْمَلَكُ بِصَرِيحِ النُّبُوَّةِ فَلَا تَقْوَاهُ قُوَاهْ ۞ وَحُبِّبَ إِلَيْهِ الْخَلَاءُ فَكَانَ يَتَعَبَّدُ بِحِرَاءٍ اللَّيَالِيَ الْعَدَدِيَّةْ ۞ إِلَى أَنْ أَتَاهُ فِيهِ صَرِيحُ الْحَقِّ وَوَافَاهْ ۞ وَذَلِكَ فِي يَوْمِ الِاثْنَيْنِ لِسَبْعَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً خَلَتْ مِنْ شَهْرِ اللَّيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِيَّةْ ۞ وَثَمَّ أَقْوَالٌ لِسَبْعٍ أَوْ لِأَرْبَعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ مِنْهُ أَوْ لِثَمَانٍ خَلَتْ مِنْ شَهْرِ مَوْلِدِهِ الَّذِي بَدَا فِيهِ بَدْرُ مُحَيَّاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-innama-btudi'a bi-r-ru'yā tamrīnan li-l-quwwati l-bashariyyah, li-'allā yafja'ahu l-malaku bi-ṣarīḥi n-nubuwwati fa-lā taqwāhu quwāh, wa-ḥubbiba ilayhi l-khalā'u fa-kāna yataʿabbadu bi-Ḥirā'in l-layāliya l-ʿadadiyyah, ilā an atāhu fīhi ṣarīḥu l-ḥaqqi wa-wāfāh, wa-dhālika fī yawmi l-Ithnayni li-sabʿa ʿashrata laylatan khalat min shahri l-laylati l-qadriyyah, wa-thamma aqwālun li-sabʿin aw li-arbaʿin wa-ʿishrīna minhu aw li-thamānin khalat min shahri mawlidihi lladhī badā fīhi badru muḥayyāh.
verses.en: And he was first given truthful dreams as a preparation for his human faculties, so that the angel would not suddenly come to him with the manifest reality of Prophethood while his faculties were unable to bear it. Solitude was made beloved to him, and he would worship at Hira for a number of nights, until the manifest Truth came to him there. This occurred on a Monday, when seventeen nights had passed of the month of the Night of Decree. There are also other opinions that it occurred after seven nights had passed, or after twenty-four nights of that month, or after eight nights had passed of the month of his birth, in which the full moon of his countenance first appeared.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ اقْرَأْ ۞ فَأَبَى فَغَطَّهُ غَطَّةً قَوِيَّةْ ۞ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ: اقْرَأْ ۞ فَأَبَى فَغَطَّهُ غَطَّةً ثَانِيَةً حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِنْهُ الْجَهْدَ وَغَطَّاهْ ۞ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ اقْرَأْ فَأَبَى فَغَطَّهُ ثَالِثَةً لِيَتَوَجَّهَ إِلَى مَا سَيُلْقَى إِلَيْهِ بِجَمْعِيَّةْ ۞ وَيُقَابِلَهُ بِجِدٍّ وَاجْتِهَادٍ وَيَتَلَقَّاهْ ۞ ثُمَّ فَتَرَ الْوَحْيُ ثَلَاثَ سِنِينَ أَوْ ثَلَاثِينَ شَهْرًا لِيَشْتَاقَ إِلَى انْتِشَاقِ هَاتِيكَ النَّفَحَاتِ الشَّذِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Fa-qāla lahu iqra' fa-abā fa-ghaṭṭahu ghaṭṭatan qawiyyah, thumma qāla lahu iqra' fa-abā fa-ghaṭṭahu ghaṭṭatan thāniyatan ḥattā balagha minhu l-jahda wa-ghaṭṭāh, thumma qāla lahu iqra' fa-abā fa-ghaṭṭahu thālithatan li-yatawajjaha ilā mā sayulqā ilayhi bi-jamʿiyyah, wa-yuqābilahu bi-jiddin wa-jtihādin wa-yatalaqqāh, thumma fatara l-waḥyu thalātha sinīna aw thalāthīna shahran li-yashtāqa ila-n-tishāqi hātīka n-nafaḥāti sh-shadhiyyah.
verses.en: Then he said to him, “Read.” He declined, so the angel pressed him with a powerful embrace. Then he said to him, “Read.” He declined again, so the angel pressed him a second time until he reached the limit of his endurance. Then he said to him, “Read.” He declined, so the angel pressed him a third time, so that he might turn with complete concentration towards what was about to be imparted to him, receive it with earnestness and utmost effort, and take it in. Revelation then ceased for three years, or according to another opinion, thirty months, so that he might yearn to breathe in those fragrant breezes once again.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ﴾ فَجَاءَهُ جِبْرِيلُ بِهَا وَنَادَاهْ ۞ فَكَانَ لِنُبُوَّتِهِ فِي تَقَدُّمِ ﴿اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ﴾ شَاهِدٌ عَلٰى أَنَّ لَهَا السَّابِقِيَّةْ ۞ وَالتَّقَدُّمَ عَلٰى رِسَالَتِهِ بِالْبِشَارَةِ وَالنِّذَارَةِ لِمَنْ دَعَاهْ
verses.tr: Thumma unzilat ʿalayhi ﴾Yā ayyuha l-muddaththir﴿ fa-jā'ahu Jibrīlu bihā wa-nādāh, fa-kāna li-nubuwwatihi fī taqaddumi ﴾Iqra' bi-smi Rabbika﴿ shāhidun ʿalā anna lahā s-sābiqiyyah, wa-t-taqadduma ʿalā risālatihi bi-l-bishārati wa-n-nidhārati li-man daʿāh.
verses.en: Then there was revealed to him, “O you who are wrapped up” (74:1), and Jibril came to him with it and called upon him. The preceding revelation of “Read in the name of your Lord” (96:1) was evidence that his Prophethood came first, preceding his Messengership through which he was charged with giving glad tidings and warning those whom he called.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
